reference.label: APIx (2026-09-10 to 2026-09-17 average = 100, provisional reference window)

methodology.elementary: Jevons -- unweighted geometric mean of matched price relatives (CPI Manual eq. 9.1; MoSPI EG 4.6.1.1 short index)
methodology.aggregation: Young -- weighted arithmetic mean of elementary index levels (CPI Manual eq. 9.11; MoSPI EG 4.6.2.4)
methodology.cell: origin x destination x carrier x departure band x advance-purchase lag; economy, non-stop, INR (MoSPI EG Recommendation 11)
methodology.item: an individual flight (carrier + flight number) matched between consecutive collection days

route.method: passenger-weighted mean-fare expenditure proxy (DGCA CY2025 pax x arithmetic mean observed fare over the base window)
route.caveat: observed fares are offers, not transactions; this is an offer-mix mean, not a passenger yield

lead.method: uniform -- a DECLARED ASSUMPTION, not derived, not attributed to ONS or MoSPI

cell.method: offers-per-day x mean fare within (route, lead); CPI Manual 4.67

methodology.imputation: explicit, from the parent aggregate's short-term movement; carry-forward is prohibited (CPI Manual 8.54)
methodology.caveat: MoSPI publishes no airfare-specific compilation rule. Airfare is one priced item, so the generic Jevons-short + Young machinery applies. That is our inference, not a published MoSPI method.

product_specification.price_concept: all-in total payable (CPI Manual 2.112: taxes are part of purchasers' prices)
product_specification.baggage: not specified by source; not controlled for

formulas.elementary_source: MoSPI EG 4.6.1.1 p.50; CPI Manual eq. 9.1
formulas.higher_level: I = sum_j ( w_j * I_j ),  sum w = 1
formulas.higher_level_source: MoSPI EG 4.6.2.4 p.53; CPI Manual eq. 9.11
formulas.imputation: Imputed Price_t = Price_{t-1} * GM(available price relatives)
formulas.imputation_source: MoSPI EG 4.6.4.3 p.56, worked Example 2 p.58

worked_examples.name: EG Example 2 -- one price missing, imputed 83.8514
EG Example 3 -- specification change with overlap
EG Example 4 -- specification change without overlap

caveats: MoSPI publishes no airfare-specific compilation rule. Airfare is one priced item, so the generic Jevons-short + Young machinery applies. That is our inference, not a published MoSPI method.
Observed fares are offers, not transactions.
Uniform lead-time weights are a declared assumption.
The reference window is three days and provisional.

frequencies_pending.W: needs two complete ISO weeks of collection
frequencies_pending.M: needs one complete calendar month of collection

coverage.note: Offered fares, not transacted fares. The reference window is provisional and will be re-referenced without revising any link.
